outputs.explanation: This is a micrograph/spatial cluster image, not a plot of averaged data.
H&E micrograph images with manual annotations; not a plot of averaged data.
Spatial gene-expression heatmap overlays on tissue sections; these are per-spot expression heatmaps, not averaged summary plots requiring individual data point overlays.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values from a single differential expression statistical test (Seurat FindMarkers) per gene, not a mean computed across multiple individual replicate measurements, so there are no underlying individual data points to overlay.
